name: Reel
text:
Use the kimtaeyoon83/mcp-server-youtube-transcript tool to pull the full transcripts directly from YouTube’s captions API. It’s faster than scraping, respects residential IP limits, and returns clean text without ads or metadata clutter.

name: Scriv
text: The real risk isn’t formatting—it’s YouTube throttling or blocking residential IPs if we hit their API too hard. A better alternative is to cache transcripts locally after the first pull, so we don’t hammer their servers. Settle it by testing a single video first: if it works without rate limits, proceed; if not, fall back to a headless browser with slower, stealthier scraping.
